text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur and I are on our way back
from an
outing when she gets a message
on her phone.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Tch.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: It's nothing serious.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I have a match scheduled in an online
game later,
but we're short a player.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's supposed to be three-on-three, so if
we're
down a player, the whole thing's
out the window.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...You?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What use would a noob like you be? Or
do you
think it's no big deal because it's
a game?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her I'll just fill the roster and try my
best not
to get in the way.
choice_data_list: 君ならお荷物が1人いても勝てるだろ？
貴方ならお荷物が1人いても勝てるでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I guess I'm not totally opposed to
playing with a
handicap...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You can play, but you've gotta do what I
say.
Don't do anything stupid, okay?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Right-click to aim, and left-click to
shoot. Move
using the W, A, S, and D
keys. You can learn the
more complex
controls as we go.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Just don't walk into our line of fire.
Right, let's
move out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bratatatatata!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: That's one kill. So far, so good.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, crap! I completely forgot about
Trainer...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I guess that was really no joke about
staying out
of my way. And yet...)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...So that's the kind of person you are,
huh? You
can't recognize talent unless
it's got an official
seal of approval on it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The hell'd you just say?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Okay, let's all calm down!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Whenever I'm about to clash with
someone,
Trainer steps in without
hesitation.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Tch.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. There's one by you.
Left-click to
shoot!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hey, we won.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I struggled to even move at first, but by
the end
of the match, I manage to help
our team secure
the win!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: もしかして俺、このゲームの才能が……？
もしかして私、このゲームの才能が……？

text_block_list.name: Teammate
text_block_list.text:
Hey, couldn't you have taken that last
one
yourself? You let your trainer have
it on purpose,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
No idea what you're talkin' about.
Probably just a
coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Teammate
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, right. That was really out of
character for
you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: That's why I said I didn't do it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I thought you weren't even interested in
this
game...
choice_data_list: おかげで楽しかったよ！
なら、次こそ役に立たないと……
どれだけ練習したらそんなに上手くなる？

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Weirdo.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even if it is just playing a game, doing
something
with Air Shakur proves to be
time well spent.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ha, fat chance.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The only thing you're allowed to do is sit
there
and keep your mouth shut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Compared to when she used to say I was
"freaking
annoying" or "couldn't take a
hint," I feel like
we've gotten a little
closer today.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I went outta my way to
practice or
anything.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I just analyzed the program for a bit to
get a feel
for the designer's style.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What's with the look? It's not like that's
illegal or
anything... technically.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm scared to dig any deeper, but I'm
once again
reminded of how relentlessly
Air Shakur pursues
her hobbies.
